# scrollsheet

React bottom sheets, drawers, dialogs, side panels, and toasts.

> Sheets use native `<dialog>` and CSS scroll snap. No runtime dependencies, ~<!--size:index.gzip:0-->16<!--/size--> kB gzipped, React 18+, MIT licensed.

scrollsheet renders a real `<dialog>` in the browser's top layer and drives its drag gesture
with a native `scroll-snap-type: y mandatory` container for modal touch gestures. Desktop
mouse dragging and some non-modal gestures use pointer handlers. Detents (resting heights)
are scroll-snap stops; spring curves are sampled into CSS `linear()` easing; enter/exit runs as an
interruptible Web Animations leg (grab a sheet mid-open, reopen mid-close, and it bends from
where it is, carrying velocity). Seven parts: `Sheet.Root`, `Sheet.Trigger`,
`Sheet.Content`, `Sheet.Handle`, `Sheet.Title`, `Sheet.Description`, `Sheet.Close`.
`Trigger`, `Content`, `Title`, `Description`, `Close`, and `Handle` take `asChild` to render your own element with the behavior
merged in. A multi-detent `Handle` exposes slider semantics (role, value, arrow/Home/End keys).
`side="center"` renders a centered modal dialog (content-sized, zoom+fade,
no travel), and `desktopSide`/`desktopBreakpoint` turn a mobile bottom sheet
into a desktop dialog, drawer, or panel at a breakpoint from two props.
Ships a Vaul compatibility layer (`Drawer`),
a Radix Dialog layer (`Dialog`) rendering the centered presentation,
and a Sonner layer (`toast`, `useSonner`, `Toaster`; `useToasts` is the neutral
name) for migrating off Sonner, all exported from the same entry and tree-shaken out unless imported.
Entry points: `scrollsheet` (import `scrollsheet/styles.css` and, for toasts, `scrollsheet/toast.css`
yourself), `scrollsheet/auto` (same exports, stylesheets embedded, injected on first open), and
`scrollsheet/motion` (experimental React-free spring, WAAPI, and scroll-tween core).

## Docs

- [Docs](https://scrollsheet.dev/docs): Install, the styling model, detents, keyboard handling, desktop drag, nesting and content morph, migrating from vaul, Radix Dialog, and Sonner, browser support, and the full API reference. One page per topic.

## Optional

- [Homepage & examples gallery](https://scrollsheet.dev/): Live, editable demos, basic sheet, detents, multi-view with content morph, nested sheets, inset card, long list with scroll handoff, non-dismissible confirm, custom backdrop, keyboard sheet, desktop drag.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ansumanshah/scrollsheet): Source, issues, and the shadcn/ui registry entry.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/scrollsheet): Install and version history.
- [Changelog](https://scrollsheet.dev/changelog): Release notes, generated from the repo's CHANGELOG.md.
- [Full docs text](https://scrollsheet.dev/llms-full.txt): A plain-text reference for tools that cannot crawl the site.
